description: List all ADRs from the Exeris ecosystem registry. Each entry carries number, title, owning repo, scope, visibility, status, and link. Optional `status` filter narrows the result by the first token of the status cell (e.g. 'accepted', 'proposed', 'superseded', 'reserved').

status.description: Filter to entries whose status.state equals this value (case-insensitive; trimmed before comparison).

name: docs-list_adrs
